page.layout: One page of text: a single column of chapter headings, each numeral on its own line above its title, with the page number at top left and a catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

l.i: De Chio & eius Statu ac fortuna.

page.notes: The "I. DE" at bottom right is a catchword. The faint signature-like mark at bottom centre is uncertain and given as [?]. Faint show-through of text from the other side is ignored. "Repubi." at XI is read as printed; "Amphictyonico" is read from a ct ligature and may be misread. The "&" is a printed et-sign, kept as printed. A faint "VII" at bottom left was not transcribed as it is unclear whether it is printed.
